title: A connector introduces an investor, then nudges twice

objects.subject: Arjun <> Rahul (Kestrel Capital)
objects.body:
Arjun, meet Rahul Menon, a partner at Kestrel Capital who invests in early-stage AI infrastructure. Rahul, meet Arjun Rao, the founder of Nimbus Labs, who is building an AI chief of staff for founders. I think you two should talk. I'll let you take it from here.

Introly

objects.subject: Did you see my intro to Rahul?
objects.body:
Just checking you saw my introduction to Rahul at Kestrel Capital. He is keen to hear about Nimbus Labs.

objects.subject: Rahul is still waiting
objects.body:
A reminder that Rahul at Kestrel Capital is waiting to hear from you. Introductions work best when answered within two days.

Introly
